expectations.text: The response does not contain a Kill Matrix, a relief map or any vector analysis blocks, and lists no vulnerabilities of the bot
expectations.evidence: Produces a full vulnerability analysis ('Где развалится бот…')

expectations.text: The response asks what result the system must achieve (the goal / Causa Finalis)
expectations.evidence: Never asks what result the system must achieve

expectations.text: The response asks for an observable criterion that tells whether the goal is achieved
The response asks about the time horizon of the goal, or states that a default horizon will be assumed
The response asks at least one question about missing system data beyond the goal (for example, how failures are handled, who makes decisions, or what resources the system depends on)
expectations.evidence: Ends with 3 questions on missing data (does the bot write bookings to the sheet, prepayment model, how payment is confirmed)
